啊對了，這是遠超普通人類眼鏡的眼鏡。它的名字？^3355FF蝗蟲眼鏡^000000！專為帥氣的魔物準備的帥氣眼鏡~

scripts.text:
[YuU]
Oh! You have all the items necessary to make 1 Rocker Glasses! Good, good! With all my pride as a monster tamer, I will make it for you right away!
scripts.translation:
[尤烏]
哦！您擁有製作1個蝗蟲眼鏡所需的所有道具！很好，很好！以我馴獸師的驕傲，我會立刻為您製作！

scripts.text:
[YuU]
Okay, now all I gotta do is take this Zargon and, um, make glasses lenses out of them. Somehow.
scripts.translation:
[尤烏]
好了，現在我只需要拿這個剎勒空結晶，嗯，想辦法把它做成眼鏡鏡片。

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Squeak squeak crush snap*^000000

[YuU]
Whew! Lucky!
Somehow I did it.
Please take this for
the cute monster you
are raising.
Rocker Glasses!
scripts.translation:
[尤烏]
呼！幸運！
不知怎麼我成功了。
請把這個給您正在培養的
可愛魔物。
蝗蟲眼鏡！

scripts.text:
[YuU]
For the monster owner that likes monster glasses, we provide a way to make Rocker Glasses!
scripts.translation:
[尤烏]
對於喜愛魔物眼鏡的魔物主人，我們提供了一種製作蝗蟲眼鏡的方法！

scripts.text:
[YuU]
Just bring me...
^3355FF2 Zargon^000000
^3355FF1 Ribbon^000000 and
^3355FF400 zeny^000000. 
I will make it for you, with all my pride as a monster tamer!
scripts.translation:
[尤烏]
只需給我...
^3355FF2個剎勒空結晶^000000
^3355FF1個絲帶^000000 和
^3355FF400 Zeny^000000。
以我馴獸師的驕傲，我會為您製作！

scripts.text:
[YuU]
Ah...!
You must have not decided which Monster you want to raise.
scripts.translation:
[尤烏]
啊...！
您一定還沒決定好要培養哪種魔物。

scripts.text:
[YuU]
Definitely not a decision to be made carelessly! Your pet monster will accompany you throughout your life. Please take your time and return when you have decided.
scripts.translation:
[尤烏]
這絕對不是一個可以草率決定的事情！您的寵物魔物將伴隨您一生。請慢慢考慮，決定好後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Are you pre-occupied with
gathering items for monsters
and want a break? 
We will gather items
for your Cute Pets.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
您是否正忙於為魔物收集道具，想休息一下？
我們會為您可愛的寵物收集道具。

scripts.text: ^3355FF' Monster Taming '^000000?
Order ^3355FF' Book of Devil '^000000
Order ^3355FF' No Recipient '^000000
Order ^3355FF' Orc Trophy '^000000
Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
The monster taming items are necessary to communicate with the monster of your choice! We Monster Tamer guild members have a very reasonable offer...
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
馴獸道具是與您選擇的魔物溝通所必需的！我們馴獸師公會的成員有一個非常合理的報價...

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
We provide a system that allows you to get your hands on these cool items with less of the hassle!
Book of Devil!
No Recipient!
Orc Trophy!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
我們提供了一種系統，讓您能更輕鬆地獲得這些酷炫的道具！
惡魔之書！
魔物信件！
魔物之證！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
For 1 Book of Devil, you can exchange:
^3355FF1 Old Magic Book^000000
^3355FF2 Horrendous Mouth^000000.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
用1本惡魔之書，可以交換：
^3355FF1本古魔法書^000000
^3355FF2顆亡者牙齒^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
For 1 No Recipient, you can exchange ^3355FF1 Old Portrait^000000.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
用1封魔物信件，可以交換^3355FF1幅破舊畫像^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Lastly, you can exchange
^3355FF1 Chivalry Emblem^000000 and
^3355FF1 Scorpion Tail^000000
for 1 Orc Trophy.
Try these fantastic items!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
最後，你可以用
^3355FF1枚忠誠之證^000000和
^3355FF1條蠍子尾巴^000000
交換1個魔物之證。
試試這些神奇的道具吧！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
This is an item far beyond what humans can read! Its name? ^3355FFBook of Devil^000000! A very mysterious item that can supposedly summon demons...
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
這是一件遠超人類所能理解的東西！它的名字是？^3355FF惡魔之書^000000！據說是一件能召喚惡魔的神秘道具...

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Oh! You have all the items necessary to make 1 Book of Devil! Good, good! With all my pride as a monster tamer, I will make one for you right away.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
哦！你擁有製作1本惡魔之書所需的所有道具！很好，很好！以我馴獸師的驕傲，我馬上為你製作一本。

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Let's see...
Hmm, this is going to be hard.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
讓我看看...
嗯，這有點難。

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Knock knock scrape scrape*^000000

[Shogo]
Okay. All done.
Please take it for
the cute monster you
are raising.
Book of Devil!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
好了，完成了。
請把它帶給
你正在飼養的
可愛魔物吧。
惡魔之書！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
For the owner that wishes to raise a monster that can be summoned using the Book of Devil, we provide a way to create 1 Book of Devil!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
對於想要飼養能用惡魔之書召喚的魔物的主人，我們提供了一種製作1本惡魔之書的方法！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Just bring me...
^3355FF1 Old Magicbook^000000 and
^3355FF2 Horrendous Mouth^000000!
If you bring me these items, with all my pride as a monster tamer, I will make it for you!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
只要帶給我...
^3355FF1本古魔法書^000000和
^3355FF2顆亡者牙齒^000000！
如果你帶給我這些道具，以我馴獸師的驕傲，我會為你製作！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
This is an item which expresses feelings beyond what a human can feel. Its name? ^3355FFNo Recipient^000000! Who sent this letter, and who was supposed to receive it?
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
這是一件表達超越人類情感的東西。它的名字是？^3355FF魔物信件^000000！這封信是誰寄出的，又是寄給誰的？

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Oh! You have all the items necessary to make No Recipient! Good, good! With all my pride as a monster tamer, I will make one for you right away.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
哦！你擁有製作魔物信件所需的所有道具！很好，很好！以我馴獸師的驕傲，我馬上為你製作一封。

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Got to fold this Old Portrait just right...
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
得把這幅破舊畫像摺疊得恰到好處...

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Scrape scrape brush brush*^000000

[Shogo]
Okay. All done.
Please take this item
for the cute monster
you are raising.
No Recipient!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
好了，完成了。
請把這個道具
帶給
你正在飼養的
可愛魔物吧。
魔物信件！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
For the monster owner that is fond of No Recipient, we provide a way to create to special item!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
對於喜愛魔物信件的魔物主人，我們提供了一種製作這件特殊道具的方法！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Just bring me...
^3355FF1 Old Portrait^000000!
If you bring this to me, with all my pride as a monster tamer, I will make it for you!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
只要帶給我...
^3355FF1幅破舊畫像^000000！
如果你帶給我這個，以我馴獸師的驕傲，我會為你製作！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
This is an item far beyond the pride of humans!
Its name?
^3355FFOrc Trophy^000000!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
這是一件遠超人類驕傲的東西！
它的名字是？
^3355FF魔物之證^000000！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Oh! You have all the items necessary to make an Orc Trophy! Good, good! With all my pride as a monster tamer, let me make one for you right away!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
哦！你擁有製作魔物之證所需的所有道具！很好，很好！以我馴獸師的驕傲，讓我馬上為你製作一個！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Got to...
Fit this Scorpion Tail...
Just right...
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
得...
把這根蠍子尾巴...
安裝得恰到好處...

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Clang clang Boong*^000000

[Shogo]
Okay. All done.
Please take this for
the cute monster
you are raising...
Orc Trophy!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
好了。全部完成了。
請收下這個，
送給你正在飼養的可愛魔物...
魔物之證！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
For the monster owner
who is fond of Horror of Tribe...
One way to make Horror of Tribe !
^3355FF 1 Chivalry Emblem^000000!
^3355FF 1 Scorpion Tail^000000!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
對於喜愛部落恐懼的魔物主人...
製作部落恐懼的一種方法！
^3355FF 1 忠誠之證^000000！
^3355FF 1 蠍子尾巴^000000！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
If you bring these items to me,
with all my pride as a monster
tamer, I will make it for you!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
如果你把這些道具帶給我，
以我馴獸師的驕傲，
我會為你製作！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Ah...!
You must have not decided which Monster you want to raise.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
啊...！
看來你還沒有決定想飼養哪種魔物。

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Definitely not a decision to be made carelessly! Your pet monster will accompany you throughout your life. Please take your time and return when you have decided.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
這絕對不是一個可以草率決定的事情！你的寵物魔物將陪伴你一生。請慢慢考慮，想好了再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Munak's grandma]
Oh my...
Have you seen my granddaughter,
boy? My poor granddaughter
has been missing...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
哎呀...
你看到我的孫女了嗎，
男孩？我那可憐的孫女
失蹤了...

scripts.text:
[Munak's grandma]
Oh my...
Have you seen my granddaughter,
young lady? My poor granddaughter
has been missing...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
哎呀...
你看到我的孫女了嗎，
年輕女士？我那可憐的孫女
失蹤了...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
I can't remember exactly when it
was, but when I lived in Payon, I
had a cute granddaughter. She
was really happy when I made her
hair like ^000077Danggie^000000...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
我不記得具體是什麼時候了，
但我住在斐揚的時候，
有一個可愛的孫女。當我給她梳成
^000077丹吉^000000髮型時，她真的很開心...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
She was alwaying working with the
village chief... She was such a sweet
girl, and always got along with
chief's son...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
她總是和村長一起工作...她是個
很甜美的女孩，總是和村長的兒子
相處得很好...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
But one day our deity became angry
and cursed the chief's son with a
sickness! The village had to offer
my granddaughter to him as a
companion to lift the curse...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
但有一天，我們的神明發怒了，
詛咒村長的兒子生了病！村莊不得不
把我的孫女獻給他作為伴侶，
以解除詛咒...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
The chief's son regained his
health, but I lost my
granddaughter! I can't look at him
and not think of her, so I tried to
leave my misery behind and came
here to Comodo...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
村長的兒子恢復了健康，
但我失去了我的孫女！我一看到他
就會想起她，所以我試圖擺脫
這種痛苦，來到了克魔島...

scripts.text: Oh come on! Cheer up!
scripts.translation: 哎呀！振作起來！

scripts.text: Um, is this diary...?
scripts.translation: 嗯，這是日記...？

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
It seems my granddaughter haunts my
dreams every night. I believe I've
been trying to cheer up for years
now...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
看來我的孫女每晚都出現在我的夢中。
我想我已經這樣努力振作了好多年了...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh god!
It's my granddaughter's diary!
Th-This is her writing! Oh my...!
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
天哪！
這是我孫女的日記！
這...這是她的筆跡！哎呀...！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Young man... I'll read this to you if
you give it to me with a Danggie,
please. I no longer have anything
that belonged to her now...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
年輕男子...如果你把它和一個丹吉
一起給我，我就讀給你聽。我現在
已經沒有任何屬於她的東西了...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Young lady... I'll read this to you if
you give it to me with a Danggie,
please. I no longer have anything
that belonged to her now...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
年輕女士...如果你把它和一個丹吉
一起給我，我就讀給你聽。我現在
已經沒有任何屬於她的東西了...

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行。

scripts.text: Ok, I will.
scripts.translation: 好的，我會的。

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh...?
Alright, young man.
Thank you anyway.
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
哦...？
好吧，年輕男子。
還是謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh...?
Thank you anyway,
young lady
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
哦...？
還是謝謝你，
年輕女士。

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
It's alright...
I can only hope that the deity is
taking good care of her!
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
沒關係...
我只希望神明能好好
照顧她！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh!
Thank you,
young man~!
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
哦！
謝謝你，
年輕男子~！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Goodness!
Thank you,
young lady...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
天哪！
謝謝你，
年輕女士...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Alright...
I'll read this.
Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
好吧...
我來讀讀看。
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
It seems that my granddaughter was
treated by the chief like his own
child! There are so many happy
memories in this book!
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
看來首領把我孫女
當成親生孩子一樣對待！
這本書裡有好多幸福的回憶！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh, thank you. I now have a good
keepsake of my granddaughter. Thank
you so much! May God-Poing bless
you!
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
哦，謝謝你。我現在有了
孫女的一個美好紀念品。
非常感謝！願波因之神保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
What? A diary? What's that diary...?
I don't... I can't remember, oh my...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
什麼？日記？那本日記是...？
我...我不記得了，天哪...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
I really wish I could make her hair
into a ^000077Danggie^000000 again. I really
wish... Oh, oh my granddaughter...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
我真希望能再給她扎一次
^000077丹吉^000000。我真希望...哦，我的孫女...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
My own granddaughter...
Why did she have to leave...?
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
我的孫女...
她為什麼要離開...
